subject: general
question: Losar festival is celebrated in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arunachal Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Losar** is the **New Year festival** celebrated by the **Monpa tribe** of Arunachal Pradesh.
 
• The festival marks the beginning of the **Tibetan Lunar Calendar** and usually falls in the month of February or March.
 
• It is one of the most important festivals celebrated by the **Buddhist community** in Arunachal Pradesh.
 
• During Losar, people clean their houses and surroundings to ward off evil spirits and welcome prosperity and happiness.
 
• The festival includes **traditional dances**, songs, and the preparation of a variety of **traditional dishes**.
 
• Losar is celebrated with vibrant decorations, prayers, and rituals in monasteries like **Tawang Monastery**, one of the famous monasteries in Arunachal Pradesh.
 
• Losar reflects the **rich cultural heritage** and deep-rooted traditions of the state.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Chhattisgarh**__

 __
 
• Chhattisgarh is known for its **tribal culture** and festivals such as **Bastar Dussehra** and **Madai Festival**.
 
• It is famous for its **natural beauty**, including waterfalls like **Chitrakote Falls**.
 
 
 
• **Andhra Pradesh**__
 __
 
• Andhra Pradesh is known for its festivals like **Ugadi**, which marks the **Telugu New Year**.
 
• The state is famous for its **Kuchipudi dance** and historical sites like **Tirupati Temple**.
 
 
 
• **Goa**__
 
 
• Goa is famous for its **Carnival Festival**, celebrated with vibrant parades and music.
 
• The state is renowned for its **beaches**, **heritage churches**, and Portuguese influence.
